title: Restriction comparison factorization by exact localization and derived units
statement: Let $h:X\to Y$, $U\subseteq Y$, $V=h^{-1}U$, $g:V\to U$, and the derived categories be as in [def-pc-derived-mayer-vietoris-canonical-data]. Let $\alpha:Rh_*L_Y\cong L_XRg_*$ be the fixed canonical open-restriction comparison, and $\alpha_0$ its homotopy sectionwise model [def-pc-derived-mayer-vietoris-open-counit-model]. Write $\lambda_X:QL_X\cong r_XQ$ and $\lambda_Y:QL_Y\cong r_YQ$ for exact-functor localization factors and $\eta_h,\eta_g$ for the right-derived units. For every homotopy object K on X one has $L_Y(\eta_h(K));\alpha_{QK};Rg_*(\lambda_X(K))=\lambda_Y(h_*K);Q(\alpha_{0,K});\eta_g(r_XK)$ in Lean functor order. No open inclusion direct image, adjunction counit or K-injectivity hypothesis occurs.

proof.text:
unfold the four factors of schemeMVOpenRestrictionComparison. For the first
factor use the determining equation of rightDerivedFunctorCompMapDerivedCategoryIso;
for the second use rightDerivedNatTrans_fac; for the third use the determining
rightDerivedUnique equation of rightDerivedFunctorCompIso. For the fourth use
rightDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory_hom_fac. The intermediate units cancel,
and the mapHomotopyCategory composition factors identify the remaining underived
natural transformation with schemeMVUnderivedOpenRestriction. This proves the
formula for every homotopy object, not only a K-injective one. Empty and full opens
are included because the equation is a factorization of natural transformations. In Lean, the private generic calculation establishes these four factorization equations for additive F and G and exact LX and LY, assuming LX preserves K-injective complexes. The scheme specialization supplies that preservation using kInjective_of_restrict_open and the equivalence Scheme.Modules.overEquiv; this imposes no K-injectivity condition on K.
